title: Medina of Marrakesh - UNESCO World Heritage Centre
facts: UNESCO identifies the Medina of Marrakesh as a World Heritage property and discusses its historic monuments and urban fabric.
UNESCO identifies the ruins of Badi Palace, Bahia Palace, Saadian tombs, Koutoubia and the Menara water feature and pavilion as monuments illustrating the medina’s heritage.
UNESCO describes Marrakech as an important historic political, economic and cultural centre and identifies Jemaa el-Fna with intangible cultural heritage.
